content: time-machine mocks time at the C layer (patches libc time functions once) making it ~100-200x faster than freezegun, which scans and monkeypatches every imported reference to datetime/time objects (cost scales with project size). time-machine is the better choice for a library with many time-dependent tests (DST edge cases, hold-expiry lazy checks) due to speed and precision; freezegun remains more ubiquitous in tutorials but is not the performance-conscious choice for 2025.
